secure.title: Secure PDF Handling
secure.description: We strictly enforce local memory processing. Your documents never leave your device. All editing operations happen in your browser using secure, sandboxed rendering — ensuring absolute privacy for sensitive documents.

offline.title: Works Offline
offline.description: SafeTools PDF Editor works fully offline via PWA support. Edit your PDFs without an internet connection — no data exposure, no dependencies on cloud services.

items.q: Can I edit text that's already in the PDF?
items.a: SafeTools PDF Editor allows you to add new text annotations on top of existing content. For full text reflow editing, we recommend using a dedicated word processor.

items.q: Are my PDFs uploaded to any server?
items.a: Absolutely not. All editing happens locally in your browser. Your documents never leave your device — ensuring complete privacy for sensitive files.

items.q: What types of edits can I make?
items.a: You can add text annotations, freehand drawings, highlights, and images to any page. You can also rotate and delete pages to reorganize your document.
